proposed_remedy_review: Capturing running loop once and registering a done observer only on before-completion abandonment is coherent with shielded worker ownership.

The observer must bind the caught cancellation explicitly: except-target primary is cleared after its suite, so a later callback closing directly over it fails. A default argument or factory capture preserves the exact object.
Retrieve and report raw completed Future failure plus actual Future and captured cancellation. Healthy outcome emits no report; preserve the existing entered-true immediate cleanup branch.
Handle unexpected Future cancellation deliberately, rather than silently dropping it or allowing a generic callback error to lose Future/cancellation association.
Adding observer to a done Future is safely scheduled; no await occurs between guard state update and callback registration. Native fixed controls must prove report scheduling before their snapshot.
Preserve raw worker exception shape and caller cancellation. This repair observes a deferred outcome; it does not await thread shutdown or extend cleanup guarantees.
